name: WEINMANN FEEDBOT W-500 sheathing robot
summary: Industrial robot on a long linear axis that picks sheathing boards and places them on timber-frame wall elements, working alongside a WEINMANN WALLTEQ multifunction bridge that fastens and cuts them. Part of HOMAG's FEEDBOT robot series for prefab wall lines.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by WEINMANN (HOMAG Group, Germany) as part of a wall line; the US dealer Stiles Machinery also offers it. HOMAG's own pages could not be read by the polite reader, so no German contact details or price are given here.

specs.value: placing sheathing boards on wall frames
specs.quote: the FEEDBOT W-500 for precise sheathing placement

specs.label: Linear axis length
specs.quote: With a linear axis extendable to over 100 feet, the FEEDBOT W-500 can span a vast working area

specs.label: Works with
specs.quote: Both systems seamlessly integrate with our FRAMETEQ and WALLTEQ series

notes: Robot travels on a linear axis along the wall line; fastening, routing and sawing of the boards are done by the WALLTEQ bridge.
